text: Crispy crust, light sauce, and a basil pop—this margherita took me right back to Naples. Service was warm without hovering. Would happily come again.
Pretty solid ramen with a silky tonkotsu broth. Noodles had good chew. Egg was slightly overcooked, but overall satisfying.
Fish tacos slapped! Fresh lime, crunchy cabbage, and tortillas that didn’t fall apart. Music a bit loud tho.
Had the tasting menu—every plate told a story. The lamb was melt-in-mouth and the panna cotta wobbled like a dream.
Friendly folks and a proper cuppa. The veggie pie was hearty and flaky. Cozy spot for a rainy afternoon.
Excellent Szechuan pepper kick—tingly in the best way. Mapo tofu was silky and addictive. Will order extra rice next time.
We shared a mezze platter and it was abundant: hummus, smoky baba ghanoush, and warm pita that kept coming. Great value.
Killer smash burger with charred edges and a juicy center. Fries stayed crisp to the last bite.
Tiramisu was cloud-light and the espresso had real depth. Staff remembered our names—nice touch.
Perfectly grilled octopus—tender, not rubbery—and a lemony potato salad I’m still thinking about.
Butter chicken was rich without being heavy, and the garlic naan was blistered just right. Portions generous.
Bright, colorful poke bowl with super fresh tuna. Loved the pickled ginger and crunchy onions.
The barista dialed in my flat white to perfection. Almond croissant was messy in all the right ways.
We did the chef’s special yakitori—juicy, smoky, and seasoned simply. Great sake list too.
Pho broth tasted like it simmered for days—clean and aromatic. Herbs were fresh, lime was juicy. Comfort in a bowl.
Loved the gluten-free crust option; didn’t feel like a compromise. Staff handled my allergy with care.
Crisp schnitzel, lemon wedge, potato salad with just enough tang. Felt like a hug from grandma (if she were Austrian).
The shawarma was juicy and the tahini had depth. Quick, friendly, cheap—what more do you want?
Carnitas were deeply porky with caramelized edges. Salsa verde bright and punchy. Will be back soon.
Steak came medium-rare as ordered, with a peppercorn sauce I could drink. Sides are shareable—good for groups.
Flaky croissants, jammy center kouign-amann, and butter that tastes like butter. Paris vibes achieved.
The cold brew is rocket fuel (in a good way). Chill playlist, plenty of plugs—remote work heaven.
Green curry was fragrant with Thai basil and Kaffir lime; heat level 3 was perfect. Jasmine rice fluffy.
Surprisingly good vegan donburi—marinated tofu and umami mushrooms. Didn’t miss meat at all.
Ethiopian platter for two was a feast—injera spongy and the lentils deeply spiced. Loved eating with hands.
Dim sum carts rolling by = instant joy. Har gow delicate, siu mai meaty. Crowded but worth it.
Brunch winner: lemon ricotta pancakes, airy and bright. Service friendly even when slammed.
The burrata special… oof. Creamy center with roasted tomatoes and balsamic that actually balances.
Great neighborhood spot—solid tap list and a burger that drips just enough. Vibes on point.
Ceviche tasted like the ocean—zesty and clean. Plantain chips stayed crisp. Will bring friends.
Solid sushi lunch set. Fish was fresh, rice temp just right. Not mind-blowing, but very dependable.
Service was a bit slow, but the paella had good socarrat. Mixed feelings overall.
Bagel was okay, schmear a tad bland. Coffee fine. Would try again if I’m nearby.
Nice patio and okay tacos; nothing special but not bad either. Good for a casual meetup.
Pad thai portion generous, flavors slightly muted. Friendly staff balanced it out.
BBQ ribs tender but sauce too sweet for me. Others might like it. Mixed verdict.
Pho broth decent, herbs fresh, but noodles a bit clumpy. Average overall.
Good value lunch combo; chicken tikka fine, naan a bit chewy. Nothing to complain about, nothing to rave about.
Fun cocktails, small plates okay. Music too loud to chat. Mixed bag.
Salmon was cooked well but needed more seasoning. Dessert saved the day. Overall okay.
Waited 40 minutes with a reservation. Pasta came lukewarm. They comped dessert, but still disappointed.
Sushi rice was mushy and fish didn’t taste super fresh. Not horrible, just not worth the price.
Burger bun fell apart and the patty was dry. Fries soggy. Meh.
Over-salted ramen broth that masked everything else. Left thirsty. Won’t return.
We got the wrong order twice and the server seemed annoyed. Food was average at best.
Cold pizza on arrival and the cheese had that rubbery tug. Delivery apologized but still… nope.
Fish and chips oily, batter undercooked in spots. Greasy aftertaste.
$19 for a sad Caesar with browning edges? Hard pass. Portion tiny.
Steak came well-done instead of medium and the replacement took ages. Lost appetite by then.
Dim sum tasted reheated; skins tough. Maybe an off day but I wasn’t impressed.
Sate kambingnya empuk bgt, bumbunya meresap. Sambal kecap + irisan tomat bikin makin nagih. Mantap!
Nasi Padangnya komplit—rendang legit, sayur nangka gurih, sambal ijo nendang. Porsinya bikin kenyang puas.
Bakso urat di sini mantul, kuahnya bening tapi berasa kaldu. Pangsitnya kriuk. Harga ramah kantong.
Ayam geprek level 3 pas di lidah, kremesnya garing. Lalap segar, nasi hangat—simple tp juara.
Soto betawi creamy, daging empuk, jeruk limau fresh. Makan siang jadi hepi.
Pempek kapal selamnya tebal dan lembut, cukonya balance antara asam-manis-pedas. Auto repeat order.
Mie ayamnya wangi minyak ayam, topping melimpah. Pangsit rebusnya lembut. Pelayanan cepat.
Ikan bakar bumbu rica pedas cabe rawit, dagingnya juicy. Sambal dabu-dabu segar banget!
Nasi uduk gurihnya pas, ayam gorengnya renyah di luar lembut di dalam. Sambal terasinya nampol.
Gudegnya manis legit, kreceknya pedes dikit, kombo perfect. Porsi pas, harga oke.
Sate padang kuah kental bumbu rempahnya kaya. Lontong empuk. Tempatnya bersih, pelayanan ramah.
Rawon dagingnya besar-besar, kuah kluweknya pekat wangi. Sambal + tauge bikin segar.
Es teler full buah, susunya ga kemanisan. Pas buat penutup makan siang.
Bebek gorengnya garing di luar, daging masih juicy. Sambal korek bikin keringetan, nikmat!
Lontong sayur pagi-pagi hangat, kuah santan ringan, kerupuknya kriuk. Bikin semangat kerja.
Sop iga seger, daging lepas dari tulang. Jeruk nipis sedikit makin mantap. Worth it.
Pecel lele tengah malam, sambal terasi pedesnya nampol. Lele fresh, nasi anget. Top buat begadang.
Ayam bakar madu, rasa manis-smokeynya pas. Lalapan lengkap. Porsi gak pelit.
Siomay bumbu kacang kental, kentang & kolnya matang pas. Layanan cepat, dompet aman.
Nasi goreng kambing pakai bumbu kebuli, aromanya menggoda. Daging empuk, porsinya gede.
Tempatnya oke, tapi ayam penyetnya biasa aja. Sambal kurang nendang. Masih ok buat makan cepat.
Rasa sotonya standar, daging sedikit tapi kuah hangat enak diminum. Harga sesuai.
Warungnya strategis, mie gorengnya lumayan walau agak berminyak. Not bad lah.
Bakmi Jawa rebusnya oke, bumbunya halus. Nggak wow, tapi mengenyangkan.
Es campur segar, tapi terlalu banyak es serut jadi cepat encer. Cukup sih.
Rendang lumayan empuk tapi kurang rempah menurutku. Pelayanan cepat, tempat bersih.
Sate taichan standard, sambal jeruk nipisnya enak tapi daging agak kering. Ya lumayan.
Tahu gejrot rasa oke, porsi kecil. Buat camilan aja, jangan harap kenyang.
Nasi ulamnya biasa, kerupuk alot sedikit. Minumannya dingin, oke buat singgah.
Kupat tahu cukup enak, bumbu kacangnya ringan. Porsi pas sarapan.
Dateng lapar, pulang kecewa. Sop buntutnya alot, bumbunya flat. Harganya ga masuk akal.
Nasi gorengnya asin parah, kayak tumpah garam. Telur mata sapi overcooked. Duh.
Menunggu hampir 45 menit padahal ga ramai. Pas dateng, sate dingin. Kapok dulu.
Ayam geprek super berminyak, kremesnya pahit. Perut jadi nggak enak.
Bakso rasanya hambar, kuah seperti air garam. Sambal pun tak menolong.
Ikan bakar gosong di luar, dalamnya masih amis. Mohon diperbaiki deh.
Pecel lele sausnya terlalu manis, lele kecil banget. Nggak sesuai foto.
Gudegnya terlalu manis, krecek keras. Harga tidak sebanding rasa.
Soto banjir minyak, bikin eneg. Sendoknya juga kurang bersih. Kurang nyaman.
Es teler isinya kebanyakan es, buahnya dikit dan layu. Kecewa.
Service was sweet but slow, yet the falafel wrap was crunchy outside and fluffy inside. Mixed feelings but I’d return.
Neapolitan-style pie with leopard spots on the crust—chef’s kiss. House chili oil is a must!
Korean fried chicken double-fried to shattery crisp. Honey garlic glaze had balance, not cloying.
Clam chowder tasted canned and was lukewarm. Bread bowl soggy. Disappointed.
Nice view over the park; coffee okay, pastry stale. You win some, you lose some.
Taco al pastor juicy with proper pineapple char. Three-bite perfection.
Overpriced salad with wilted greens. Dressing bland. Wouldn’t recommend.
Pasta cacio e pepe glossy and pepper-forward—simple, perfect. House red paired nicely.
Roti canai crispy edges with a soft center—curry dip aromatic. Hit the spot for late dinner.
Wartegnya bersih, sayur tumisnya enak tapi tempe orek terlalu manis dikit. Tetep lumayan kok.
House-made gnocchi like tiny pillows, sage butter fragrant and not greasy. Extra points for the friendly sommelier.
Smoky brisket with a legit bark and tender center. Cornbread held up, not crumbly. Solid queue worth it.
The poke had super clean tuna and warm rice—yes! Wish the edamame had more salt, but still great lunch.
Curry laksa creamy, layered, slurpable. Bean sprouts crisp, tofu puffs soaked up flavor.
Loved the tapas flight—garlic shrimp sizzled, patatas bravas crunchy. House sangria was not too sweet.
Sourdough crust pizza with airy cornicione. Chili-honey drizzle on the pepperoni was cheffy and fun.
Bulgogi bowl balanced sweet and savory. Kimchi bright. Portion looks small but very filling.
Perfect cortado and a toasted banana bread slice with walnut bits. Cozy nook to read in.
Oysters tasted like the sea—ultra fresh. Mignonette had snap. Staff knew their regions.
Tandoori chicken juicy with charred edges; mint chutney bright. Garlic naan blistered and buttery.
Big hearty burrito, rice not mushy (phew). Extra pico on the side was clutch.
Falafel platter generous—crispy outside, tender inside. Pickles cut through the tahini nicely.
Soba noodles chilled just right, dipping sauce umami-rich. Simple but so satisfying.
The crab cakes were all crab, barely any filler. Lemon aioli on point. Would order again.
Vegan mushroom shawarma rocked—smoky, juicy, and wrapped tight. You won’t miss meat.
French onion soup with a deep beefy base and a proper cheese pull. Classic done right.
Neat little wine bar: small plates shine. The burrata + grilled peaches combo? Chef’s kiss.
Jerk chicken had real scotch bonnet heat. Rice & peas fluffy, plantains caramelized, not burnt.
Pho ga clear and aromatic; shredded chicken moist. Extra herbs without asking—love that.
The smash patty had lacy edges and legit beef flavor. Pickles sharp. Great quick bite.
Crisp schnitzel sandwiched on a soft roll with mustard and kraut—simple, perfect lunch.
Wood-fired cauliflower with tahini and pomegranate. Didn’t expect to rave about veg, but here we are.
Great kids’ menu, patient staff, and a silky risotto for the grown-ups. Family-friendly without feeling chaotic.
Excellent espresso martini and a charred octopus starter that was tender all the way through.
Spicy tuna roll clean and tidy; nigiri cuts generous. Quiet lunch spot for sushi cravings.
Cacio e pepe was glossy and pepper-forward; portion could be bigger, but flavor nailed.
Gouda mac n’ cheese had a smoky note that worked. Crispy breadcrumbs for texture. Comfort food win.
Bibimbap sizzling hot, yolk mixed into a dreamy sauce. Crunchy rice at the bottom—yes please.
The gelato flight is dangerous—hazelnut especially nutty. Worth the line.
Tart lemon bars and a fluffy carrot cake slice. Coffee good, pastries better.
Nice patio. Burger fine, nothing special; fries a tad under-seasoned. Average hangout.
Ramen broth okay but lacked depth; noodles cooked right though. I left half-satisfied.
Decent tacos, inconsistent tortilla warmth. Salsa bar helps. Overall fine for the price.
Hummus creamy, pita a bit chewy. Service kind but distracted. Mixed experience.
Caprese salad good ingredients, skimpy basil. Entrees came lukewarm but flavors okay.
Sushi roll creativity high, execution middling. Fish fresh, rice packing uneven.
Breakfast sandwich decent; could use a punchier sauce. Coffee strong. Would go again if nearby.
Pad see ew sweet side for me, but wok hei present. Portions generous.
BBQ pulled pork nice texture, sauce too sweet. Coleslaw balanced it somewhat.
Seafood paella had good socarrat but a couple clams were tiny. Not bad, not great.
Cold fries, salty steak, and a pricey bill. They did offer a free dessert but mood already tanked.
Naan came burnt in patches, curry tasted flat. Surprised given the hype.
Overdressed salad and watery tomatoes. For a farm-to-table spot, that’s a no from me.
Clam chowder gritty—sand? Also lukewarm. Couldn’t finish.
Pizza dough underbaked, gummy center. Toppings slid off like a landslide. Disappointing.
Service forgot our order entirely. After 50 minutes, we left. Can’t rate the food we never got.
Pho broth tasted muddled, almost bitter. Bean sprouts wilted. Not coming back.
Tacos cold, tortillas cracked, meat dry. How do you mess up three things at once?
Cocktail menu reads great, but mine was syrupy and unbalanced. Bar vibe nice, drinks not.
$24 for a tiny poke bowl with stringy salmon. Felt like a tourist trap.
Sate maranggi empuk, bumbu kecap pedas manisnya pas. Nasi panas bikin makin nikmat.
Lontong kari pagi-pagi, kuah santannya wangi rempah, kerupuk udang kriuk. Mantap sarapan!
Nasi liwet gurih, ayam bakarnya smoky. Sambal terasi bikin keringetan, bahagia.
Bakmi lebar teksturnya pas, topping ayam jamurnya melimpah. Pangsit goreng renyah!
Iga bakar madu legit, daging lumer. Plecing kangkung segar jadi penyeimbang.
Gado-gado bumbu kacang kental, lontong empuk. Krupuknya banyak, puas.
Sop konro kuahnya dalem, daging besar-besar. Jeruk nipis sedikit bikin seger.
Nasi campur Bali lengkap: lawar, sate lilit, ayam suwir. Sambal matah juara!
Es kopinya bold, roti bakar selainya tebal. Tempatnya santai buat kerja.
Pempek kulit renyah, adaan lembut. Cuko pedes-asem seimbang. Nagih banget.
Ayam betutu rempahnya nendang, sayur urab crunchy. Porsi cukup buat dua orang.
Mie aceh tumis pedasnya nampol. Dagingnya banyak, bawang goreng wangi.
Soto mie Bogor lengkap—risol, babat, emping. Kuahnya segar, tidak terlalu berlemak.
Roti canai garing-lumer, kari kental. Harga bersahabat. Bakal balik lagi.
Bubur ayam creamy, topping melimpah: cakwe, ati ampela. Kuah kaldunya gurih.
Tahu tek bumbunya medok, lontongnya pas. Porsi bikin kenyang tapi ga eneg.
Asinan Betawi seger, kuahnya nge-blend antara asam-manis. Pas buat siang panas.
Nasi goreng kambing kebuli: aromanya aduhai, daging empuk. Acar nanas unik.
Ikan bakar jimbaran bumbu olesnya meresap, sambal matahnya segar. Sunset view bonus.
Martabak manis tebal tapi gak bantet, topping kejunya royal. Kopi susu pas manisnya.
Bakso aci pedas gurih, kolesterol? bodo amat 😂 Enak pol!
Ayam rica-rica pedesnya nyelekit, daun jeruk wangi. Nasi tambah dua kali.
Sate taichan juicy, sambal jeruk nipis seger. Cocok buat nongkrong malam.
Mendoan hangat dimakan sama cabai rawit—bahagia sederhana. Teh panas refill terus.
Timlo Solo gurih ringan, isiannya lengkap. Cocok buat yang ga suka terlalu pedas.
Rawon setan pedasnya serius tapi bikin nagih. Daging empuk, kerupuk udang on point.
Ayam penyet sambalnya jos gandos, tempe tahunya hangat. Porsi hemat tapi kenyang.
Sate kelinci (halal) bumbunya meresap, teksturnya lembut. Baru tau enak juga ya.
Kupang lontong segar, petisnya wangi. Bonus es degan, adem banget di siang terik.
Bubur Manado (tinutuan) sayurnya banyak, gurihnya pas. Sambal roa bikin naik level.
Nasi uduk oke tapi ayam gorengnya biasa saja. Masih lumayan buat sarapan cepat.
Bakmi cukup enak, cuma agak asin. Porsinya pas, harga standar.
Soto banjar lumayan, kuah agak tipis rasanya. Pelayanan ramah sih.
Es campur seger tapi kebanyakan sirup. Buahnya oke. Tempatnya sempit.
Rujak cingur bumbunya bagus tapi cingurnya sedikit alot. Overall masih oke.
Pecel daun singkong lumayan, bumbu kacang agak encer. Porsi murah meriah.
Ayam bakar manisnya dominan, saya prefer yang smoky. Lalapan segar menyelamatkan.
Mie kocok dagingnya enak, kuahnya standar. Kerupuk melinjonya renyah.
Sate padang sausnya oke, cuma lontong agak keras. Mungkin kebetulan.
Kopi susu kekinian biasa aja, tapi rotinya enak. Wifi kenceng.
Nasi padang mahal tapi rasa ga sepadan. Rendangnya kering, santan pecah. Kecewa.
Bakso pucat dan hambar, sambalnya ga membantu. Antri lama pula.
Ayam geprek super berminyak, sambal pahit. Perut jadi mules. No thanks.
Gudeg over-manis, opor dingin. Kayak makanan sisa. Sedih sih.
Ikan bakar amis, saus mentega terasa gosong. Nasi dingin. Zonk.
Sate kambing alot, bumbu kacang pecah minyak. Pelayan jutek. Nggak balik lagi.
Es teler isi kebanyakan es batu, alpukatnya pahit. Rp20k? Kebangetan.
Rawon hambar, daging sedikit. Kerupuk melempem. Mending cari yang lain.
Bubur ayam asin berlebihan, cakwenya lembek. Telur setengah mateng gagal total.
Nasi goreng smokey? yang ada gosong. Telur orak-ariknya dingin. Kapok.
Lobster roll stuffed to the brim, buttery bun with a nice toast. Side of slaw actually crisp—summer on a plate.
Risotto al funghi was creamy with that earthy hit; perfectly al dente. Server nailed the wine pairing.
Chicken tikka wrap was juicy, chutney bright, and the roti didn’t tear. Quick, tasty lunch.
The churros were hot and cinnamony, dunked in real chocolate. Simple joy.
Char siu had lacquered edges and deep porky sweetness. Rice fluffy, greens crisp.
Avocado toast with feta and lemon zest—basic? Sure. But they did it so well.
Tonkatsu perfectly fried, pork still juicy, curry sauce rich and comforting. Portion just right.
Cevapi plate took me back—smoky grilled sausages, ajvar tangy, bread warm and soft.
Margarita was balanced and strong; the birria tacos dripped with flavor. Napkins required.
Paneer butter masala velvety and spiced, not just sweet. Garlic naan blistered with char—yes.
Branzino roasted whole with lemon and herbs—skin crisp, flesh delicate. Felt coastal.
Bibimbap with extra gochujang hit the spot. Loved the crunchy nurungji bits at the bottom.
Banana leaf thali—so many flavors! Sambar, rasam, pickle, crunchy papad. Great vegetarian feast.
Fried calamari tender, not rubbery. Aioli garlicky and bright. Solid starter.
The pastrami sandwich stacked high, pepper crust singing. Mustard bitey, rye fresh.
Pistachio gelato tasted like actual nuts, not essence. Smooth as silk.
Thai basil chicken had real wok hei; fried egg with runny yolk sealed the deal.
Shakshuka bubbling hot with fluffy pita on the side. Cozy brunch vibes.
The grilled cheese came with a tomato soup that tasted roasted, not canned. Childhood but upgraded.
Sourdough pie with vodka sauce and burrata—indulgent but balanced. New favorite slice.
Tapas night: anchovies on toast, jamón, manchego—simple, beautiful flavors done right.
Pho tai with rare beef that actually stayed tender. Lime and basil fresh. Comfort bowl.
Crispy duck salad with tart cherries and peppery greens—smart combo. Would order again.
Burrito bowl had charred corn, bright salsa, and juicy carnitas. Fast but quality.
The espresso was syrupy and sweet; croissant layers shattered in the best way. Paris vibes.
Smoked salmon bagel loaded but balanced—capers, red onion, dill cream cheese. Breakfast win.
Gnocchi gorgonzola rich but not heavy, walnuts for crunch. Cozy date spot.
Horchata latte with cinnamon dusting and a warm concha—sweet start to the day.
Jollof rice had depth and a gentle heat; suya skewers smoky and tender. Delicious.
Udon in a dashi that tasted clean and ocean-y. Tempura still crisp after a dip.
Good burger, average bun. Pickles great. Would I rush back? Maybe, maybe not.
Sushi lunch set fine but uninspired. Fish fresh, rice a bit compacted. Meh overall.
Decent falafel wrap, tahini a little thin. Portion fair for the price.
BBQ ribs tender but glaze too sweet for my taste. Cornbread nice though.
Pad Thai leaned sweet; wok hei slight. Not bad, just okay.
Clam chowder creamy enough, clams scarce. Bread roll warm saved it.
Coffee good, croissant day-old feel. Quiet space to work, so still useful.
The pizza toppings solid, crust underdone in the center. Mixed feelings.
Charcoal grilled squid flavorful, sides forgettable. Service friendly.
Tacos had great salsa but tortillas cracked. Value fine, execution mixed.
Over-salted risotto and a limp side salad. Pricey for what it was.
Ramen broth flat, chashu dry. Egg was cold in the middle—why?
Fish n chips soggy, oil tasted old. Lemon wedge couldn’t rescue it.
The wings were tiny and over-fried. Sauce tasted bottled. Disappointing.
Sushi rice mushy, knife work sloppy. Felt careless for the cost.
Waited 35 minutes for a lukewarm latte. Staff overwhelmed and it shows.
Steak came well-done after I asked for medium. Replacement took forever. Appetite gone.
Paella gummy, seafood overcooked. No socarrat in sight. Sad.
Burger arrived cold, fries stale. They offered a voucher but I’m not keen.
Poke bowl skimpy on fish and heavy on rice. Not worth the hype.
